name: Bichota Coffee
neighborhoodOrCity: George Floyd Square, south Minneapolis (3740 Chicago Ave.)
whatItIs: Specialty coffee café and roastery with a Puerto Rican owner; the name comes from Puerto Rican slang. Hosts art shows, writing circles and pop-ups; staff unionized soon after opening in 2024.
evidence: Own site lists current coffees and subscriptions and says the café is open at 3740 Chicago Ave. Racket (Oct. 7, 2024) and KSTP covered the opening; Mato venue page lists recent events.

name: Ricardo Levins Morales Art Studio
neighborhoodOrCity: Longfellow area, south Minneapolis (3260 Minnehaha Ave.)
whatItIs: Studio and store of the Puerto Rican-born artist Ricardo Levins Morales, selling movement posters, prints, buttons and zines.
evidence: Own site shows the Minnehaha Ave. address, a 2026 copyright and 2026 products, including a zine on the 2026 Twin Cities enforcement surge.

name: NewPublica
whatItIs: Multicultural public relations and strategic communications firm; Twin Cities Business (2024) said former state Sen. Melisa López Franzen, a native of Puerto Rico, had been its president. Edits a Minnesota Hispanic directory.
evidence: Own site shows the Bryant Ave. address and posts dated March 13 and June 6, 2026.

name: La Prensa de Minnesota
whatItIs: Spanish-language news outlet serving Latino Minnesotans broadly; listed for context, not as a Puerto Rican-owned business (ownership was not confirmed).
evidence: Own site shows articles dated as recently as Oct. 30, 2026.

name: La Borinqua
neighborhoodOrCity: Albert Lea; served events in southern Minnesota including Owatonna
whatItIs: Puerto Rican food trailer run by Amanda Velazquez, with plantain nachos and a mostly gluten-free menu based on family recipes.
evidence: The latest opened article is from 2022 (Owatonna People's Press). No 2025 or 2026 sign of operation was found.

name: El Jibarito Restaurant and food truck
type: restaurant and food truck (Puerto Rican food)
neighborhoodOrCity: Twin Cities area (exact location not confirmed)
whatItIs: Family-owned Puerto Rican restaurant with a food truck and catering, as listed in a 2022 University of Minnesota StoryMap.
evidence: Only a 2022 listing was found; no own website or recent dated post was found.

name: Sosa Foods & Deli
whatItIs: Small takeout spot with mofongo and tostones at the center of its menu.
evidence: Only a July 1, 2012 Mpls.St.Paul Magazine review was found; no current sign of operation.

name: SotaRico
whatItIs: Production company and independent record label founded by artist and legislator María Isa Pérez-Vega; the source of the term SotaRican.
evidence: Sahan Journal (Nov. 8, 2022) and a 2022 StoryMap describe it; no own site or 2025-2026 activity was found.
